'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Cedrik Vanderhaegen LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-1st-place-ls-cedrik-vanderhaegen-hidden-base/ PC list]
